bullets.content: [general] Use all 4 solves, one factor each. Write each solve's single factor in the plan before meshing. After each: read top-5 hotspots and local h, view(kind=error, iso and -z), then compare() best vs runner-up before submitting. Submit by error vs DOFs.

[general] Name the ONE factor changed vs last submitted recipe in the first message ('changed X from a to b vs solve n'). Multi-factor changes were unattributable. Before solving, write the break-even (e.g. +5.2% nodes needs >=0.26% SE); after, compare in one line.
[general] Never re-solve a stored recipe: meshing is deterministic. Solve 1 must be a new mesh; compare against stored SE and DOFs. Don't re-test settled notes. 18% compare diff means unconverged.
[general] REPEATED: solves left unused. Plan: S1 tweak, S2 known best fallback, S3 second one-factor tweak, S4 best combination. view(error,-z) after each; compare before submit.
[general] Free-mesh scan before solving: node counts jump between meshes (e.g. 5571 vs 7281 nodes). Check nodes and min quality (>0.1) before spending a solve.
[general] Call view(kind=error, iso) and view=-z after every solve. Check the bright error band lies inside your finest refinement before the next mesh.
[general] Compare solves by estimated score (error vs DOFs) before submitting. A small DOF drop with a larger error was not worth it.
[general] When a tweak shows no energy change, stop and submit; spend spare solves on a bolder single change (e.g. finer root) rather than a marginal box extension.

[general] A compare() region marks where the field CHANGED, not where the error is. Place refinement from the solve's own top-5 hotspots and view(kind=error). Misreading a compare region made a run drop edge 18.

[general] Calibration held: ZZ eta x1.22-1.6 matched true field error (14.4% x1.22 = 17.6% vs 17.7%). Compute est. score ((0.3186/(1.22*eta))/2)^2/(DOFs/6057) per candidate; submit highest only when clearly below target, else refine hotspot band.

[general] Break-even: +0.175% SE for +5.7% DOFs still lowered base 0.237->0.232. Below target, relative field-error drop must be >=0.5x relative DOF rise. Require >=0.25% SE per +5% DOFs before accepting a refinement.
[general] 21.6k vs 16.7k DOFs gave only a 5.9% stress change; +29% DOFs not worth it. Decide by score per DOF.

[general] Thin walls (~2.5 mm): if hotspot local h exceeds wall thickness, bending is under-resolved. A local box only 1.4x finer than h is mostly swallowed: make it >=1.6x finer (e.g. 0.003 under h 0.005) or drop it; verify via hotspot local h.

[general] Edge refinements deliver poorly when hotspot sits 0.2-0.8 mm off the edge (edges 39/8 at 0.0026 gave h 0.0038-0.0040, 1.5x). Cover such bands with a box spanning the edge ±2 mm at the same size.
[abc_00000003_bc7] [general] [abc_00000003_bc7] [general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Strain energy convergence is a weak guide to stress-field error here; use compare() between solves and hotspot shares.

[abc_00000003_bc7] Saddle boxes [±0.010..±0.017,y±0.012,z0.019-0.030] at 0.0026: +0.175% SE, field 16.31->16.04%, +5.7% DOFs, base fell 0.237->0.232. Delivered h 0.00327. Pay only via bonus; widen or fund them. Reached field 16% at 25.8k DOFs vs control 17.7% at 22.4k.

[abc_00000003_bc7] Control tweak: widen saddle boxes to |x| 0.010-0.0215, z 0.019-0.032 at 0.0026 r0.002, covering f16/f19 rim hotspots (x≈±0.0195, z 0.030, h 0.0038-0.0040) that edges 39/8 miss. Target rim h <=0.0033. Self idea: f16/f19 groups 0.003 r0.004 (hotspots #2,#5 17-19% error).
[abc_00000003_bc7] Spend S2 on DOF saving: widened-saddle recipe minus edges 39/8. Accept if SE drops <0.05% while nodes fall >=3%; would lift base above 0.232.

[abc_00000003_bc7] Never coarsen upper or lower boxes: h 0.011 + upper 0.0052 + lower 0.0048 lost 0.30% SE for -4.2% nodes; upper 0.0055 lost 0.26%. Keep upper 0.0048. Lower 0.0046->0.0040 gave only +0.05% SE for +5.2% nodes; keep 0.0046.
[abc_00000003_bc7] Highlight a4: at h 0.015 same boxes gave 8009 nodes (vs 8125 at h 0.0095), 0.033691 J. Above h 0.012 global h is inert for nodes but costs energy. Keep h 0.0095.

[abc_00000003_bc7] Clamp ring z≈0.056 by f20 holds ~20% of error (h 0.0045-0.0047, hotspots 21-22% vM; P1 -16.8%), just above upper box top. Teacher: leave f2 0.0033 r0.005. Self idea: box [-0.02,-0.02,0.05,0.02,0.02,0.061] at 0.0032 r0.003 replacing upper box.

[abc_00000003_bc7] Hidden-point bonus came from distinct error pattern (best point RMS 6.47%); keep mesh structurally distinct from a2/a4. Field (16%) binds over check points; spend DOFs on the diffuse band.
[abc_00000003_bc7] Used only 2 solves last time. Plan: S1 ring box 0.0032, S2 f16/f19 0.003, S3 combine, S4 DOF trim; compare by estimated score.

[abc_00000003_bc7] [general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Next mesh call: h=0.005, order 2, same two junction boxes 0.0035 r0.004, clamp box [-0.02,-0.02,0.05,0.02,0.02,0.061] size 0.003 r0.003. Clamp ring (z~0.056) held ~16% of error at h 0.0041; P1 -24%. Don't go below 0.0025 (singular). Self idea: f2 0.0025 r0.006.

[abc_00000003_bc7] [general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Global h is the strongest lever: h 0.009 gave 0.03165 J, h 0.0065+boxes 0.0028 gave 0.03300 at 26.4k, h 0.005+boxes 0.0035 gave 0.03352 at 22.35k. Keep h 0.005; never coarsen lower body (z<0.015) above 0.005. Supersedes earlier coarsen-to-0.0065 plan.

[abc_00000003_bc7] [general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Edges 39/8/40 at 0.0022-0.003 never pay (23.8k DOFs 0.033464 J vs 22.35k 0.033518 without); they miss hotspots 1-2 mm off edges. Never add to box recipe; use boxes or f16/f19 groups.

[abc_00000003_bc7] [general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Junction boxes 0.0035 under h 0.005 were swallowed: saddle hotspots near f16/f19 (x~±0.0195, z 0.030) at h 0.0044-0.0048. Read element size near f16/f19; if >0.0042, refine. Self idea: f16/f19 at 0.003 r0.005; error is diffuse (235 hotspots hold 80%).

[abc_00000003_bc7] [general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Spare-solve idea, not control: saddle boxes x [0.016,0.024] and [-0.024,-0.016], y ±0.012, z [0.026,0.034] at 0.003 r0.003 atop control. Targets hotspots #4-#6 (~8% error), ~+1-2k DOFs; compare against control.
[abc_00000003_bc7] [general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Keep f2 refinement cheap (clamp band z~0.056, ~3% error per cell). Peer a6's f2 0.0025 r0.006 gave h 0.0035; try if hotspots stay at z>0.05.

[abc_00000003_bc7] [general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Highlight a6: single junction box [-0.024,-0.014,0.019,0.024,0.014,0.036] 0.0036 r0.003 at h 0.0055 gave best base (0.228, 17.6%, 21810 DOFs). Equivalent to our two side boxes at h 0.005; keep ours for diversity, don't copy.

[abc_00000003_bc7] [general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Worst hidden check point near f23 around (0.017,-0.013,0.005); test moderate f23 refinement at 0.004 after the clamp tweak. Check-point error (8.84%) is below field error (17.7%); P1 clamp fix should help both.

[abc_00000003_bc7] [general] [abc_00000003_bc7] [general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Setup verified: fixed f2; pressure 4e6 Pa on f23, 2.1e6 on f16; E 2.1e11, nu 0.3, 3d. Reaction z-sign flips between meshes are noise (bore pressure self-equilibrates); don't change setup.

[abc_00000003_bc7] [general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Field error binds (17.7% vs check 8.84%). Misses at P1 -24% (clamp), P0 +11.6%, P3 +12.4% are low-stress; don't refine separately. Uniform refinement barely pays; move DOFs into junction/clamp bands.

[abc_00000065_bc0] [general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Teacher call (control): mesh(h=0.0074, order=2, refinements=[wall box 0.0035 r0.003, root box 0.0025 r0.003, pocket box [0.016,0.012,-0.0081,0.026,0.03,-0.003] 0.003, f5 sub 0.0016, f7 sub 0.0016, all r0.003]). Edge 22 may be dropped (see tweak note).

[abc_00000065_bc0] [general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Root box 0.0022 gave only h≈0.0028 at f5 root (x≈0.0199) and f7 root (x≈0.0265), z≈-0.0073: 38% of error. Nested 0.0018 sub-boxes (z -0.0081..-0.0055) reached 0.0026, cut #1 17%→12%. Use 0.0018. Self idea: size 0.0016 r0.005 to pull h below 0.0022.

[abc_00000065_bc0] [general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Never leave the f5 side of the clamp root unrefined. Dropping edge 18 and starting the box at x 0.016 left f5 at h 0.0062 and hotspots at h 0.0039-0.0041 with 7-8% vM (22.5% of error). Root box must span x 0.016-0.030.

[abc_00000065_bc0] [general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Mesher branch: at h 0.0074 quality.min 0.20-0.29 = expensive branch (7211-7281 nodes); ~0.11 = cheap (5571). Root 0.0022 + sub 0.0016 triggered expensive; root 0.0025 avoids it. Never solve a mesh >10% above cheapest scanned.
[abc_00000065_bc0] [general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Root box 0.003 with 0.0016 sub-boxes gave quality.min 0.079 (invalid) and lost accuracy. Keep root 0.0025; don't retest 0.003.

[abc_00000065_bc0] [general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Tweak: drop edge 22 (0.0025 equals root size, likely no-op). Accept if nodes <5571 and SE >=2.1335e-4. If nodes >5700 (branch switch), solve the exact base and submit the cheaper.

[abc_00000065_bc0] [general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Hotspot #1 (12%, f7 root y +0.0083, h 0.00298) and #4 (6.1%, f5 y +0.0065, h 0.0030) lie outside sub-boxes. Spare test: f7 sub y max 0.005->0.009 at 0.0016; keep if nodes <5800 and SE gain >=0.05%.

[abc_00000065_bc0] [general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Sub-box 0.0016 gives only h 0.0024-0.0026 at hotspots (~1.6x lag), same as 0.0018. Below 0.0016 risks expensive branch; don't chase smaller (a5's variant).

[abc_00000065_bc0] [general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Point error nearly binds: 8.28% vs field 8.45% at h 0.0074 (6.69% at h 0.007; a5 5.49% at 0.0072). Never raise h above 0.0074; cheaper mesh must not push point RMS above field error.
